items.author: Kelsall Commercial Kitchens
items.title: Vantorre CX-10 10-tray electric combi, refurbished (listing KCK-4471)
items.body: Fully refurbished 2021 Vantorre CX-10, 10 x 1/1 GN. Steam generator descaled and pressure tested, new door gasket, core probe calibrated. 6 month parts and labour warranty. Delivered and commissioned metro Melbourne. $14,800 inc GST. Seller: Kelsall Commercial Kitchens, Dandenong South. Buyer reviews close at the end of the 60th calendar day, counting the delivery date as day one.

items.author: noreply@chefmarket.example
items.title: Order CM-88213 delivered
items.body: Your order CM-88213 (Vantorre CX-10 refurbished, listing KCK-4471) has been marked delivered and commissioned at Little Gertrude, Fitzroy. Total paid $14,800.00 inc GST. Warranty registered to 14 March 2027.

items.author: service@kelsallkitchens.example
items.title: Service report SR-1190 Little Gertrude
items.body: Attended 22/09. Fault: E34 steam generator low water level, intermittent lockout in combi and steam modes. Replaced water level sensor. Tested 3 x steam cycles OK. Warranty, no charge. Tech: Dion

attachments.name: SR-1190.txt
attachments.content: Unit CX-10 s/n VT21-30877. E34 x 9 in error log since 14/09. Level sensor replaced. Inlet pressure 320 kPa OK. Job time 1.5 hr. Warranty.

items.author: tash@littlegertrude.example
items.title: RE: Service report SR-1190 Little Gertrude
items.body: hi Dion E34 is back, 4 times this week. also core probe is reading low, tested against our thermapen in a lamb shoulder, oven said 63 and thermapen said 70. Did it twice same result. can someone come out early next week pls. Tash

items.author: service@kelsallkitchens.example
items.title: Service report SR-1236 Little Gertrude
items.body: Attended 06/10. Steam generator found heavily scaled, descaled and flushed. Core probe recalibrated, now within 1 degree. Recommend site installs water softener as scale indicates hard water supply. Tech: Dion

items.author: tash@littlegertrude.example
items.title: water hardness
items.body: rang the water co. Fitzroy supply avg hardness about 15 mg/L as CaCO3, they said thats soft, some of the softest in the country. oven only 3 weeks on our water when Dion found the scale. so it was scaled when it got here??

items.author: brett@kelsallkitchens.example
items.title: CX-10 callout 27/10
items.body: Hi Tash, Dion reports the unit was again showing E34 on 27/10 and he found further scale. As advised on 06/10 this is a site water issue and not covered under warranty, so the 27/10 attendance will be invoiced at our standard callout of $280 + GST ($308 including GST). We'd also ask that you hold off on any ChefMarket review while we work through this with you, as we're confident it's a site issue. Regards, Brett Kelsall

items.author: noreply@chefmarket.example
items.title: How did your Vantorre CX-10 go?
items.body: Your review window for order CM-88213 closes Thursday 12 November. Reviews help other kitchens buy with confidence. Sellers can post one public response to each review.

items.author: sal@littlegertrude.example
items.title: the oven review
items.body: Tash go ahead with the review, dont let Brett talk us out of it. Facts only, dates, codes, the probe numbers, the water thing. No swearing and nothing that sounds like we're having a go at Dion, he's been fine. Leave it as a draft and I'll read it Wed morning before I hit submit. Sal

items.author: sal@littlegertrude.example
items.title: Saturday incident - PRIVATE
items.body: Tash, keep this between us and the insurer. Jaz's forearm burn from the oven door on Sat 17th is now with WorkSafe, notification ref WS-2026-554871. Lawyer says nothing about it goes anywhere public, reviews included, until it's closed. Thanks for doing the first aid so quick.
